title: Description of the clinical picture of adults with rare genetic syndromes
summary:
Currently, there is very little information on the clinical picture of rare diseases in adulthood.
For this reason, we would like to compile the clinical picture of adult patients with rare genetic diseases in this study.
In particular patients with a genetically confirmed diagnosis of Nicolaides-Baraitser or Cofiin-Siris or Costello or Cardio-Fazio-Cutaneous (CFC) syndrome.
Through this study, we would like to increase the knowledge in the field of those rare syndromal diseases and thereby contribute to an improvement in the care and prevention options for the patients.
conditions: Other specified congenital malformation syndromes, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Non-interventional Study: prospective data collection by questionnaire (Questionnaire_Study:"Description of the clinical picture of adults with rare genetic syndromes")

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Molecularly confirmed diagnosis of one of the following four syndromes: 
Nicolaides-Baraitser syndrome
Coffin-Siris syndrome
Costello syndrome
CFC (Cardio-facio-cutaneous) syndrome

- Written informed consent from the participant or the legal guardian if the participant has a legal guardian.
Exclusion criteria:
- Individuals with a syndromal disease without molecular genetic confirmation.
- Age<18 years
- No consent for data collection in the context of this study
